Auth.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual.
Auth.slowBody: Tally is still trying to restore your session. Check the wifi, then reload — or sign in again to start fresh.
Auth.coreOnlyBody: This part of Tally is for the core team. Checking students in is all yours.
Auth.checkingBody: Looking for you on the team in Planning Center…
Auth.grantedBody: Planning Center has you on the team. Your access is set up.
Auth.grantedBodyWithRole: Planning Center has you on the team as {role}. Your access is set up.
Auth.stuckBody: Tally is having trouble opening on this device. Your access is fine — reloading normally sorts it out.
Auth.notFoundBody: That email is not on the team in Planning Center, so Tally cannot let you in yet.
Auth.notFoundHelp: Ask a core team leader to add this address to the team in Planning Center, then try again. If you normally use a different address, sign out and use that one.
Auth.inactiveBody: Your Tally access has been turned off. Planning Center still lists you, but someone on the core team has marked you inactive.
Auth.inactiveHelp: A core team leader can switch it back on from Settings.

Checking them in here again undoes the release by itself.
